title: WeaponForm
description: Data schema for a specific weapon stage/evolution Form in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

id.description: Unique identifier for the weapon form.

seriesId.description: Identifier of the parent Series this form belongs to.

name.description: Display name of this weapon form.

description.description: Flavor text and details of the form.

modelAsset.description: Path to the Skyrim model mesh file (.nif).

abilityIds.description: List of form-bound ability IDs granted by this form.
